calculation.description: Cross-asset short-term reversal whose strength increases during a rising-volatility (VIX shock) regime and is attenuated otherwise. VIX is observation-only and no order is placed for it. All inputs are completed daily observations.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year 2020-2026; 2022 was strongest and 2025 weakest but positive. Small cross-asset universe requires conservative uncertainty interpretation. High correlation with plain five-day reversal indicates likely redundancy under deterministic library audit.
